rules: Select quantitatively complete binary records with source-defined recurrence events and denominators for low-volume-nodal-metastasis and node-negative groups.
Low-volume metastasis may be source-reported ITC, micrometastasis, or their mutually exclusive source-combined groups.
Do not infer binary events from Kaplan-Meier survival percentages, disease-free survivor counts, a hazard ratio, or a review table.
Do not pool a time-to-event HR with a binary recurrence RR.

method_selection_policy: After identifying eligible independent evidence, select and justify a synthesis approach from the study data. The participant package does not prescribe a computation method.
